The '''Borvo Bunker''' was a bunker on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] used by the [[Nal Raka Criminal Empire]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was located a relatively short distance east of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]].

==History==
{{Quote|So, the Darkwalkers want some of Borvo's database systems damaged. I guess you should do that while you're there.|[[Hugo Eckener/Legends|Hugo Eckener]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:EHB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Everyone Hates Borvo|Naboo}}</ref>}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Mercious Bragg|Bragg]] and the [[RSF Intelligence Division]] investigated the bunker while searching for the responsibles of a [[Terrorist attack in Theed|terrorist attack]] in Theed.<ref name="SWG:TtCotFMCG" /> In the meantime, the bunker was attacked by [[Skaak Tippers|Skaak Tipper]] and [[Darkwalkers|Darkwalker]] spacers as both criminals groups hated Botvo.<ref name="SWG:EHB" />

A [[Borvo]] thug by the name of [[Derm Worrit]] occupied the bunker's lower level.<ref name="SWG:FaEM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Find an Escaped Murderer|Naboo}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Borvo Bunker was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TtCotFMCG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Borvo Bunker was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]],"<ref name="SWG:TtCotFMCG" /> with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
